AreaFrontend.title: A new brand is a configuration change
AreaFrontend.description: Pick a brand or move the hue: the components on the right only read semantic tokens, so they re-theme without touching their code. It is the same 3-layer model as the real white-label.

AreaBackend.title: One payment, even if you click twice
AreaBackend.description: Simulate a charge's lifecycle. Try «Double-click pay»: the second attempt finds the obligation's lock and returns the same payment with the same idempotency key. At the end, replay the webhook: the already-applied event is ignored.

AreaCompliance.title: Every verdict explains why
AreaCompliance.description: This is how the KYC engine processes a file: five steps, from attachments to verdict. Scroll to walk through them; on the right, the verdict with the reason for each check.

steps.title: Classify
steps.description: Identifies each document's type and discards the ones that don't belong.
steps.sample: id → voter ID · proof → utility bill · certificate → tax status

steps.title: Extract
steps.description: Extracts the fields with an LLM and normalizes them to a typed schema.

steps.title: Checks
steps.description: Runs checks and cross-validations by person type and risk tier.
steps.sample: validity · name match · recent address · RFC ↔ certificate cross-check

steps.title: Verdict
steps.description: Stores the result with the reason for each check, ready for review.
steps.sample: needs review · 3 of 4 checks OK · 1 to review

verdict.title: verdict
verdict.subject: Ana Ejemplo Ruiz · individual · new client

checks.name: ID validity
checks.reason: Expires in 2029: valid on the request date.

checks.name: Name match
checks.reason: The name matches across all three documents.

checks.name: Recent proof of address
checks.reason: It is 95 days old; the policy requires 90 or fewer.

checks.name: RFC ↔ tax certificate cross-check
checks.reason: The extracted RFC matches the one on the certificate.

AreaDevops.title: Verify only what changed, and fail if there's nothing to verify
AreaDevops.description: Run the pipeline and compare before and after the merge-request gate I built: lint, typecheck, tests and build scoped to the MR diff, caching only the package-manager store. The times are the measured ones.

scope.before: Every MR verifies the whole repository and caches node_modules.
scope.after: Every MR verifies only the files in the diff (git merge-base) and caches only the package-manager store.

outcome.passed: pipeline passed: the MR can be merged.
outcome.emptyDiff: lint failed: the change list came back empty. The gate fails instead of passing green without verifying anything.

items.title: mentoring
items.body: Mentoring means keeping the reasoning visible, not just the solution.
items.evidence: I wrote 116 of the 196 RFCs and ADRs of a frontend platform, and mentored a team that grew from 3 to 5–6 engineers.

items.title: hiring
items.body: A team grows well when whoever leads it helps choose who joins.
items.evidence: At Centria the frontend team grew from 3 to 5–6 engineers over 4 years, with my input on hiring.

items.title: decisions
items.body: A decision is written down with its evidence and corrected in public if its premise fails.
items.evidence: An ADR of mine assumed a premise that turned out false; the next day I corrected it in writing, keeping a record of the mistake.
